name: Rotating Platform
description: A 2×2 turntable that spins 90° anti-clockwise on every pick, carrying its boxes to new positions.
howToPlay: The 2×2 metal turntable in the middle holds four colored boxes, but only the box that lines up with the open channel below it can be picked. Every box you pick — the plate box OR one of the purple boxes at the bottom — spins the turntable one quarter-turn anti-clockwise. Use the purple boxes as free 'spins' to bring the color you want down into the channel, then grab it. Empty the plate and it clears away.
author: Claude

showcaseLevel.name: Rotating Platform
showcaseLevel.desc: Time your picks to spin the box you need into reach
